verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents an API for sending customer requests to the Customer Agent and for running the Internal Agent from your own tools. The evidence never mentions an official SDK or client library in any language, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. A raw API is an adjacent building block, not an official SDK, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
